notes:
Qualification notes:
- Background: SMB, ticketing/chat product focused on small-medium enterprises. Self-serve signup completed 2026-02-28; low initial usage (~5k tokens/day).
- Primary ask: improve user-visible response latency for chat widget across EU and NA customers. NA feels OK (~250-350ms p95 for short replies), EU p95 observed ~700-900ms during demo.
- Quote from demo (CS lead): "EU users complain the chat is sluggish vs our expectations — feels like 1s+ for short responses."
- Observed configuration: using hosted_api region unspecified in client (defaults to us-west), SDK timeout set to 10s, no streaming enabled, prompt templates include 2x long system messages and entire KB excerpt as context (token-heavy).
- Customer constraints: cost-sensitive (SMB), wants predictable latency without heavy engineering lift; will stay on public cloud hosted API if perf is fixed. No VPC or private deployment required. SOC2 in place but no strict residency needs.
- Perf targets discussed: p95 < 350ms for conversational responses (short turn, <120 tokens); acceptable fallback to p95 < 600ms for long doc-search responses.
- SE notes / recommendations given on call:
  * Region selection: test eu-west-1 (nearest) vs eu-central to confirm lower RTT; suggest routing EU traffic to eu region explicitly in SDK.
  * Timeouts: reduce client-side timeout to 6s for interactive calls; implement streaming with partial render to improve perceived latency.
  * Prompt guidance: remove duplicate system messages; use short system + dynamic retrieval snippets limited to 150 tokens; move long KB excerpts to embeddings + rerank flow.
  * Batching/caching: enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompt stubs; enable small batching window for high concurrency paths.
  * Model choice: start with a low-latency open variant (quantized) for short chat; configure fallback to higher-quality model for >300 token replies.
- PoC plan: two-week sandbox where Redwood will provide region latency benchmarks and a sample streaming integration. Milestones:
  1) Week 0: baseline metrics (done 2026-03-01) — attached ff meeting.
  2) Week 1: region pinning + streaming POC in staging (target: p95 < 400ms)
  3) Week 2: prompt optimizations + cost estimate, handoff to billing if comfortable.
- Current blockers: lack of guidance doc they can hand to frontend engineer; need concrete timeout + streaming snippet. Also want simple A/B steps to validate.
- Next steps agreed: Samir to send tailored perf tuning checklist, sample streaming client code, and region benchmark csv by 2026-03-07. Schedule follow-up 30m on 2026-03-10 to review results.
- Internal notes: potential to convert to self-serve seat expansion if p95 improves; estimated ARR $10–50k with 12–18 month expansion runway.
- Linked artifacts: pricing deck + security FAQ in Drive, Fireflies demo transcript id above, Jira INF-2247 opened for initial latency investigation.
